name: Truncated Tensor Decomposition
definition: A rank-reduced approximation where the multilinear rank $(R_1, R_2, ..., R_N)$ is explicitly chosen to be smaller than the initial ranks $(I_1, I_2, ..., I_N)$ to achieve compression.
summary: Truncated Tensor Decomposition compresses volume data by reducing Tucker model ranks, uniquely exploiting core tensor all-orthogonality to discard negligible components while minimizing reconstruction error.
